page.notes: The right-margin notes are small and partly illegible; they include marginal references such as "Vienne, Archiepiscopales", "Vienne Antiquitas", "Supplicationum institutio", "Tornonium Vinum in Agro Vien.", "Fabula de Pontii Pilati", "Ebrodunum, Ambrun". Several are only approximately readable and are not transcribed exactly. Marginal word "Brannovii" and "Gratianopolitanorum" are also in the right margin. Greek words in the text are approximate. Several words in the main text are uncertain and not marked individually; the text is rendered from a poor scan.
